rationale: The breakdown below the $10.72 session low failed to hold, with the most recent 1-minute candle flushing to $10.68 before immediately reversing to close at its high of $10.75. With only 11 minutes remaining until market close and the price reclaiming the breakdown level, the immediate downside momentum is negated and closing at near breakeven avoids late-day short-covering risk. Flipping to long is unattractive given the stock remains deeply below VWAP ($11.19) with an 18.6 bps spread right before the bell.
